create_VotingModule: create a VotingModule instance with a vote factor and seed feature dimension for 3D point cloud voting
run_VotingModule_forward: run the VotingModule forward pass to generate vote coordinates and features from seed point XYZ and features
test_VotingModule: test the VotingModule by passing random seed XYZ and feature tensors and checking output shapes
review_VotingModule_conv_layers: review the VotingModule conv1, conv2, conv3 layer configuration and batch normalization setup
refactor_VotingModule_residual_features: refactor the VotingModule forward method to modify how residual features are computed and added to vote features
